agent_priors_used: General prior (exploration/exploitation): a research program can keep generating locally-strong packets while the global decision it exists to inform stays unmade; when a critical-path prerequisite is missing, funding downstream threads is negative expected value. This is the basis for refusing the flagship benchmark and funding B1/B2/B3.

General prior (substrate-First repair): a measurement that repeatedly returns MEASUREMENT_INVALID for an exogenous leak (not for the hypothesis) should be repaired once in the shared substrate rather than re-run as a fresh experiment each cycle, to avoid paying the same discovery N times. Applied to Runtime replacing the oracle re-run with the task-bank certification.

General prior (decision-theoretic stopping): a bounded go/no-go certificate (constructibility, attainability, non-degeneracy) is worth one cycle because it either unblocks a whole thread or closes it cheaply, whereas re-running a mined estimator family adds little marginal information. Applied to Graph (D1V constructibility), Frontier (discovery-frame certificate), Physics (timescale attainability).

General prior (specification vs capability): when a same-model agent fails a task, prompt underspecification and model capability ceiling are distinguishable only by a controlled prompt/variant test; without it the failure mode is unidentifiable and any benchmark built on it is uninterpretable. Used to justify Intel's C-LLM-INHERIT continuation as a prerequisite.

General prior (degraded-tooling trust): when a reconnaissance source is degraded, its content is a continuity artifact rather than independent evidence, and must not anchor strategic pivots. Applied to the DEGRADED Scout brief.
These are general agent/research-system priors only. None is SPIDER-established evidence; SPIDER evidence is restricted to Codex accepted events and exact packets cited below.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION, with an explicit duplicate-avoidance guard. Legacy P2-REPLAY-COST (sha 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b) is the load-bearing negative: bare replay's 8.5x cache-cost claim was withdrawn and matched at ~1.002x, so replay cannot be sold as agent economics. The current mandate deliberately does NOT fund a replay-economics claim; it lands an audited inherited-PARAMETER carrier with a refusal certificate, a different object. I checked legacy_artifact_index.json: 'parameter' yields 0 artifacts and 'inherit' yields the graph inheritance-scaling lineage (id 105 sha 3b3ed7b457a2ca72b930ceb171e2f157fb17d36b; G-H4/G-H5 reuse-scaling), which is about memory-led reuse at depth, not about an executable parameterized carrier in the shipped kernel, so it is adjacent precedent rather than duplication. Legacy P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION (sha 017a80aeb9a6759c8f6913a37031ff1616ec1bda) is the second guard: it warns that a positive arm result can be an artifact of weak baselines, so the promotion certificate must include a refusal case against a strong comparator. Because the shipped-kernel carrier has never been validated and the prior replay-economics claim is a documented withdrawal, this allocation spends its cycle on the distinct, permitted step (promotion), not on re-testing replay economics or inherited-parameter benefit, so it is not a paid duplicate.
allocation.question: Can the audited parameterized inherited carrier be landed into the shipped kernel through the sanctioned promotion path — i.e. after promotion the shipped execution path contains a concrete parameterized mechanism that an inherited procedure visibly instantiates and executes, together with a companion known-negative refusal certificate — such that B1 is satisfied and the pre-freeze executable mechanism required by readiness condition (1) exists, rather than once more running the four-arm economics benchmark on a kernel that still emits literals below the execution threshold?
allocation.rationale: This is a substantive SUPERSEDE of the lane's own handoff. Product's local handoff proposes the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT/C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark on a model endpoint, but the Director's readiness gate (this cycle's binding rule) forbids that expensive execution until all three conditions hold, and only condition (1) is even partially met. src/spider/kernel.py still has no distill_parameterized() and creates literal candidates at confidence 0.5 below the default 0.8 threshold, so a benchmark run now would measure a Product treatment that cannot execute inherited parameters — a guaranteed non-informative result. The audited carrier certificate already exists as an artifact (arm-differential on synthetic plus a live real substrate), so the missing step is promotion into the shipped path, which is the highest-leverage Product action per the global audit and a prerequisite for the flagship benchmark rather than a substitute for it. C-PARAM-INHERIT is in-charter and EXPERIMENTAL, so landing it does not promote an untested mechanism past the evidence: C-PARAM-INHERIT becomes PRODUCT_CORE because the promotion must carry a positive AND a known-negative refusal certificate; if the promotion cannot reproduce a positive mechanism plus the negative refusal on the shipped path, the claim stays EXPERIMENTAL and B1 remains open. Guard: money/latency accounting is explicitly out of scope this cycle (it requires B2), so the lane must not smuggle C-PRODUCT-ECON unaudited.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER's Research 2.0 factory is architecturally converged (freshness guard, parameterized capsule carrier, delta-repair, measurement-validity oracle, asymmetric task bank, same-model agent) but has NOT produced the one decisive result: a same-model end-to-end demonstration that inherited parameterized mechanisms cut cost per successful partially-novel Web task without false-accept inflation. The 2026-10-10 global audit reduces this to three joint blockers: B1 (ship the audited parameterized carrier in src/spider/kernel.py, which still lacks distill_parameterized() and emits literal candidates at confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 execution threshold), B2 (a task bank with genuine cold/retrieval dynamic range and honest counters), and B3 (settle the credential-free capable-model question). All three prerequisites are currently owned and in flight (Product=B1, Runtime=B2, Intel=B3); none is a scientific result yet. Consequently the expensive flagship C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark must NOT be funded this cycle. The remaining lanes (Graph, Physics, Frontier) are each on bounded decision gates that either unblock a consumer or self-park cheaply. Every lane currently holds a live PREFREEZE mandate whose object was already re-oriented by the prior audit; I am confirming those mandates (USE where local and active direction coincide; SUPERSEDE where a lane's own handoff still proposes the pre-audit object that the flagship gate forbids). Two lanes therefore change direction in substance even though the action token is CONTINUE: Runtime continues C-MEAS-VALID only by certifying the task bank (not by re-running the twice-MEASUREMENT_INVALID oracle), and Product continues C-PARAM-INHERIT only by landing the shipped carrier (not by running the benchmark a fourth time on a substrate that cannot yet move). No lane is idle, no frozen EXECUTE is outstanding, and no lane has an unfinished frozen experiment that conflicts with these directions.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Research Scout ran DEGRADED (recursive model call returned rc=124, model unavailable). Its brief therefore contains only internally-derived candidate_directions and explicitly zero agent_priors; it is a continuity artifact, not reconnaissance. I treated each Scout candidate as a staff proposal and re-derived every allocation from the machine snapshot, the effective_event_by_claim state, and both program audits, rather than adopting the brief. The Scout's three posed questions were answered by the audit's blocker analysis rather than by new external information, and I did not spend the cycle on broad browsing. The one externally-flavored element the Scout could not supply (competitor datasets/baselines that would change B2 or B3 design) remains a live gap; I have left it to be resolved inside Intel's B3 work and Runtime's B2 work under their existing mandated questions, rather than inventing a fourth dependency or a browse task for a degraded source.
